February 1, 2025

# Removing unnecessary `RELEVANCE` sort options

DateFebruary 1, 2025

Version[2025-04](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-04)

Flags[Breaking API Change](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=breaking-api-change)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)[Customer Account API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=customer-account-graphql)

`RELEVANCE` will no longer be included in connection sort options by default as of `2025-04` API versions. This will eliminate cases where the option offered no unique behavior, and acted as a basic `ID` sort. Legitimate cases where this option provides unique capabilities and services regular traffic will not change.
